# MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3 Calibration checks - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01  
This revision supersedes Rev B

Scope
- Procedure for calibration verification of measuring systems and setpoints on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 during Heat Treat operations. Applicable to maintenance and quality personnel assigned to P3, line P3-L4.

Tools
- Calibrated laser micrometer or equivalent as referenced in SOP-P3-L4-02
- Dial indicators and magnetic bases compliant with SOP-P3-L4-03
- Manufacturer-approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-315
- Calibration tags and record forms per SOP-P3-L4-05

Procedure
- Verify that the work envelope and measurement fixtures accommodate rings up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 2150 mm. Record fixture configuration used.
- Install dial indicators and laser micrometer per SOP-P3-L4-02. Confirm zeroing on the known reference surface and tag instruments with calibration status from SOP-P3-L4-05.
- Perform static run-in checks of the measuring heads for full traverse; note any binding or repeatability errors, and document on the calibration record referenced in SOP-P3-L4-05.
- Inspect lubrication points and top up only with lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-315. Log part number and batch on the maintenance form.
- If measurement deviation or mechanical irregularity is found, suspend production use of EQ-P3-L4-RR01, complete fault report, and follow escalation in SOP-P3-L4-03.

Acceptance criteria
- Measurement system returns repeatability within the limits defined in SOP-P3-L4-02 and is documented on the calibration tag per SOP-P3-L4-05.
- No mechanical binding or abnormal wear observed during checks.
- Lubrication verified with lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-315 and recorded.
- Equipment fit for Heat Treat operations for ring sizes up to the maximum ring outer diameter for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 2150 mm; otherwise, place out of service and notify maintenance.
